text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheered on with high expectations from so 
many spectators, Taiki Shuttle fires 
herself up, determined not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeating Silence Suzuka in this race 
would mean consecutive Short-distance GⅠ 
victories. Furthermore, it could open the 
path to becoming "Horse Girl of the Year."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To become who she wants to be... Taiki 
Shuttle charges forward!
